description: Waitlist CLI for Texas Roadhouse. Find a nearby store, read the quote, join and leave the list.

novel_features.name: Sniffed waitlist join
novel_features.description: Join a store waitlist through the sniffed POST /waitlist/{extref}/submit surface (no public API). Store path uses extref not internal id; email is required; party size max 6; WaitMinutes comes from quote MinQuote.

novel_features.name: Numeric waitlist cancel
novel_features.description: Cancel a waitlist request. The upstream body requires waitlistRequestId as a JSON number (string flags 400); siteId is the store extref.

novel_features.name: Sniffed waitlist check-in
novel_features.description: Mark the party HERE after the guest texts HERE once everyone has arrived (REMOVE to leave) via sniffed POST /waitlist/{extref}/checkin. Not a host-stand visit.

novel_features.name: Quote MinQuote lookup
novel_features.description: Read per-party-size MinQuote/MaxQuote for a store extref so submit can send the required WaitMinutes.

novel_features.name: Store extref lookup
novel_features.description: List nearby restaurants; waitlist paths use store extref, not the internal store id.
